title: Giving the Devil His Due: The Making of the 'Daredevil' Director's Cut
original_title: Giving the Devil His Due: The Making of the 'Daredevil' Director's Cut
overview: This documentary examines the longer Director's Cut edition and the editing of the film. We hear comments from Avi Arad, Gary Foster, Mark Steven Johnson about the choices made to pare down the film for theatrical release and other changes made for the director's cut as well as ratings issues.
